cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500 ft MSL, when directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 12). When directed, switch to CH 8:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, course rules Aransas County.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules Aransas County.

cards.detail: The binder gives no check-in phrase for a Beach Line departure to Aransas County; this follows the Mustang pattern. Verify with an instructor.

cards.title: Cross the beach line, turn north
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Beach Line Departures/Foxtrot/Noth Mustang Transition
instructions: Turn north and parallel the beach line at ½ WTD
Cross the island north of San Jose

cards.title: Maneuver to the initial
instructions: Descend to 1,000' MSL · 200 KIAS for the 2 NM initial
